title: Roguelike RPG -  The Yokai Train
author: Majestic-Solution677
selftext:
Hi, Im working on a project based on my love of Tactic games, and a couple of ideas that intrigued me, including this episode of Adventure time where they go into this infinite Train, I added Yokai since Im quite interested in mythology in general and have been adding monsters from other cultures as well, is there any interesting character in your country that you would like to give more attention to?  
Bows, Magic books, Swords, and more!  
  
The current version has capture, breed, decor, and of course adventure roguelite RPG with hundreds of hats, equipment, rings, and SATELLITES.

Demo at : [https://jontyp07.itch.io/the-yokai-train](https://jontyp07.itch.io/the-yokai-train)
